claims.claim: 7-speed transverse dry dual-clutch transmission with electro-hydraulic mechatronic control unit and separate dry clutch pack assembly, maximum factory input torque rated at 250 Nm.
claims.source_organisation: Volkswagen AG / Audi AG Service Training

claims.claim: 6-speed transverse wet multi-plate dual-clutch transmission with integrated mechatronic module operating in common transmission fluid circuit, maximum factory input torque rated at 350 Nm.
7-speed transverse wet dual-clutch transmission developed for MQB platform applications, rated for up to 420 Nm input torque.
Heavy-duty 7-speed transverse wet dual-clutch transmission designed for high-torque commercial (Transporter) and performance (RS3/TTRS) applications.
7-speed longitudinal wet dual-clutch transmission engineered for Audi Quattro longitudinal powertrain layouts.
claims.source_title: Self-Study Programme 429: Audi 7-Speed Dual-Clutch Gearbox 0B5 / S tronic

claims.claim: Fault code P17BF indicates Hydraulic Pump Play Protection active, commonly triggered by hydraulic pressure leakage in the mechatronic hydraulic circuit.
claims.source_title: VAG Technical Service Bulletin & Diagnostics Manual DTC P17BF

claims.claim: Fault code P0841 indicates Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch Circuit Range/Performance fault, reflecting out-of-range sensor readings.
claims.source_title: Volkswagen Group Guided Fault Finding System DTC P0841
claims.source_url_or_reference: ODIS / VAG Workshop Manual Diagnostics Chapter 37

claims.claim: Fault code P189C indicates Function Restriction due to Insufficient Pressure Build-Up, logged when hydraulic pressure does not reach operating threshold.
claims.source_title: VAG Powertrain Diagnostic Manual: 0AM/02E Transmission DTCs

claims.claim: Fault code P2711 indicates Unexpected Mechanical Gear Disengagement, logged when the TCU detects shaft disengagement under load.
claims.source_title: SAE / ISO Standard Diagnostic Trouble Codes for Dual Clutch Transmissions
claims.source_organisation: Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) / VAG Diagnostics

claims.claim: OEM factory service schedule specifies transmission fluid and filter change every 40,000 miles to prevent clutch friction contamination of valve body solenoids.
claims.source_title: Volkswagen Maintenance and Inspection Schedule: Direct Shift Gearbox (DSG) 02E
